sn45.134-138:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Yamunā nadī- || Seyyāthāpi bhikkhave Acīravatī nadī- || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Sarabhū nadī- || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Mahī nadī- || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo || seyyatthīdaṃ Gaṅgā Yamunā Acīravatī Sarabhū Mahī || sabbā tā samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu- -nibbānapabbhāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu- a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānapoṇo nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Gaṅgāpeyyālo || || Tassa uddānam || || Cha pācīnato ninnā || Cha ninnā ca samuddato || Ete dve cha dvādasa honti || peyyālī tena vuccatī ti || || Gaṅgāpeyyalī pācīnaninnā pācīnamaggi || Vivekanissitaṃ dvādasakī paṭhamakī || || II. RĀGAVINAYA. Idha- -bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānam dosa- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ- || || Rāgavinayadvādasakī dutiyakī samuddaninnan ti || || III. AMATOGADHA. Idha- -bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti amatogadham amataparāyanam amatapariyosānaṃ- || || Amatogadham dvādasakī tatiyakī || || IV. NIBBĀNANNINO. Idha- -bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇam nibbānapabbāram || evam kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento- -bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Gaṅgāpeyyālī || ||
sn45.134-138:2.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Cha pācīnato ninnā || cha ninnā ca samuddato || Ete dve cha dvādasā honti || Vaggo tena pavuccatī ti || || Nibbānaninno dvādasakī || || catutthakī chaṭṭhānavakī
